name: Perak Transit Berhad
overview: 2026年，Perak Transit Berhad 的业务动态主要围绕 Terminal Perlis Sentral 特许经营权管理谅解备忘录的延期与更新，该备忘录已延长至2026年5月8日，以便双方敲定最终协议；此外，公司进行了股份拆细及凭单转换相关的附加上市，并派发了2026财年的中期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, Perak Transit Berhad's business developments mainly revolved around the extension and updates of the memorandum of understanding for the concession to manage Terminal Perlis Sentral, which was extended to 8 May 2026 to allow the parties to finalise a definitive agreement; in addition, the company undertook additional listings related to share subdivision and warrant conversions, and declared interim dividends for the financial year 2026.

segments.name: IPTT 运营
segments.note: 该板块今年主要涉及 Terminal Perlis Sentral 特许经营权管理谅解备忘录的延期与状态更新。
segments.note_en: This segment mainly involved the extension and status updates of the memorandum of understanding for the concession to manage Terminal Perlis Sentral.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司更新该谅解备忘录状态，表示没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: The company provided an update on the status of the memorandum of understanding, stating there was no material development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 双方同意将谅解备忘录延长至2026年5月8日，以便有更多时间谈判并敲定最终协议。
actions.text_en: The parties mutually agreed to extend the memorandum of understanding until 8 May 2026 to allow more time to negotiate and finalise a definitive agreement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Perlis Sentral 与 Majlis Perbandaran Kangar 就管理 Terminal Perlis Sentral 特许经营权的谅解备忘录没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: There was no material development on the memorandum of understanding between Perlis Sentral and Majlis Perbandaran Kangar for the concession to manage Terminal Perlis Sentral.
